تستكفوا (form X)
# تَسْتَكِفُّوا (tastakiffū) /tas.ta.kif.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَكَفَّ (istakaffa)
# تُسْتَكَفُّوا (tustakaffū) /tus.ta.kaf.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَكَفَّ (istakaffa)
